title: Cataloguing Cuttlefish
statement: In a warm, lamp-lit tank of swaying kelp and sunken bookshelf stones, this patient little curator spends its days sorting pebbles and shells into tiny, thoughtful exhibits, rippling looping script-like patterns across its skin as though writing a label for each one. Linger a while and it will drift over, hover politely at the glass, and rearrange its collection into something it seems to hope you'll like.
